Your analysis starts with real data

No GA4 query has been run in this workspace. Import a snapshot to reveal the funnel, segment comparisons, daily trends, and a diagnostic brief.

Ordered purchase funnel

Sessions that complete each stage in sequence.

Strictly increasing timestamps within one session. Tied timestamps and skipped stages do not qualify.

Investigation brief

Descriptive evidence, not a causal diagnosis or a revenue forecast.

Device comparison

View-to-purchase completion with descriptive 95% Wilson intervals.

Acquisition-source comparison

First-user source is not the source of this session or an advertising attribution model.

Daily completion

Daily cohorts use the first observed session event in the extraction window.

Intervals assume independent sessions. Repeat visitors can violate this assumption; use them descriptively. Segment differences may reflect traffic mix, tracking, or other confounders. No significance or causal claims are made.

Check the measurement before the message

These checks cover the entire imported extraction, independently of the overview filters. They identify potential issues; they do not certify tracking completeness.

Import a snapshot to inspect data-quality results.

01 · Extract the source

Download the project. Use your own Google Cloud project with BigQuery enabled and Application Default Credentials.

python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
gcloud auth application-default login
python pipeline.py --project YOUR_PROJECT --dry-run
python pipeline.py --project YOUR_PROJECT

Start with November 1–7, 2020. Each query has a configurable 2 GB billing cap. Inspect the dry-run estimate before execution.

02 · Review and explore

The pipeline produces output/snapshot.json and a standalone output/report.html. Import the snapshot here, or launch the included Streamlit app:

streamlit run streamlit_app.py

Run the regression suite:

python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

BigQuery SQL and live extraction remain unverified until executed against your project. No refresh schedule or alerts are active.

Measurement contract

Unit of analysisSession, identified in SQL by user_pseudo_id + ga_session_id. Identifiers never enter the snapshot.
Funnelview_item → add_to_cart → begin_checkout → purchase, in that order within the same session. Completion denominator: product-view sessions.
CoverageOnly events in the requested dates are read. Sessions crossing extraction boundaries may be truncated. Missing identities are excluded and counted.
DimensionsDevice and first-user acquisition source from the first observed event of the session. Unknown and obfuscated values are retained.
InterpretationHistorical obfuscated data may contain inconsistencies. Observational findings suggest investigations and experiments, not proven causes.
Excluded metricsROAS, profit, causal campaign lift, and recovered revenue require additional data and design. They are not inferred here.
AutomationThe CLI is repeatable and generates reports atomically after validation. Scheduling and cloud alert delivery are not configured.
